description: Plan safe programmatic SEO templates with uniqueness rules, indexation gates, internal links, schema guidance, and launch QA. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

audience.description: Intended reader or buyer group in plain language; do not include unnecessary personal data. Type: String. Maximum: 180 characters. Optional; no client default.

competitors.description: Competing brands or domains to compare using the data supplied to this workflow. Type: Array. Maximum: 20 items. Default: [].

items.description: One competing brand or domain name used in the comparison. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 160 characters. Required.

conversion_cta.description: Proposed conversion call-to-action text for the template; no transaction is initiated. Type: String. Maximum: 120 characters. Optional; no client default.

data_sources.description: Descriptions of the datasets available for the proposed template; no credentials or live dataset connection. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 20 items. Required.

items.description: One dataset description with its provenance, freshness and available columns. Type: Object. Required.

fields.description: Column names available in this supplied data source. Type: Array. Maximum: 80 items. Default: [].

items.description: One available dataset column name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 80 characters. Required.

freshness.description: Update frequency of the supplied dataset; this does not configure a refresh job. Type: String. Accepted values: "real_time", "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "quarterly", "static", "unknown". Default: "unknown".

name.description: Human-readable name of the supplied dataset or source. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 120 characters. Required.

type.description: Provenance category of the supplied dataset. Type: String. Accepted values: "first_party", "product", "user_generated", "licensed", "public", "manual", "unknown". Default: "unknown".

include_internal_linking.description: Include internal-linking guidance in the plan when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

include_schema.description: Include structured-data guidance in the generated plan when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

keyword_pattern.description: Keyword template with named variables, for example best {category} in {city}. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

page_count_estimate.description: Estimated number of pages in the proposed rollout, not a request to create that many pages. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 1000000. Default: 100.

page_goal.description: Primary outcome the proposed programmatic pages should support. Type: String. Accepted values: "traffic", "lead_generation", "trial_signup", "demo_request", "purchase", "authority", "support". Default: "lead_generation".

playbook.description: Programmatic SEO template strategy to plan; custom allows a caller-defined pattern. Type: String. Accepted values: "templates", "curation", "conversions", "comparisons", "examples", "locations", "personas", "integrations", "glossary", "translations", "directory", "profiles", "custom". Default: "custom".

publishing_cadence.description: Proposed rollout pattern for the plan; does not schedule or publish pages. Type: String. Accepted values: "pilot", "weekly_batch", "monthly_batch", "bulk_import". Default: "pilot".

sample_records.description: Example dataset rows keyed by column name. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans or null, not nested arrays or objects. Type: Array. Maximum: 10 items. Default: [].

additionalProperties.description: Value for the named sample-record column; nested arrays and objects are not accepted. Type: String, number, boolean or null. Required.

items.description: One sample data row keyed by column name; values must be scalar strings, numbers, booleans or null. Type: Object. Required.

propertyNames.description: Column name for a supplied sample record. Type: String. Required.

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Your target brand, domain or URL used to scope this workflow; supply the entity you want assessed. Type: String. Optional; no client default.

unique_fields.description: Dataset column names that provide distinct evidence or value across generated pages. Type: Array. Maximum: 80 items. Default: [].

items.description: One dataset column that provides distinctive page content or evidence. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 80 characters. Required.

url_pattern.description: Proposed URL/path template using the supplied variables, for example /{category}/{city}; no URL is published. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 180 characters. Required.

variables.description: Variable names available for substitution into keyword and URL patterns. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 30 items. Required.

items.description: One variable name available in the template patterns. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Maximum: 80 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_content_programmatic_template
title: AgentSEO Programmatic SEO Template
